comment: Sentinel benchmarks for the paired base-vs-head run (redesign section 4.1) and the section 4.5 source map. Sentinels are composite microsecond-to-millisecond workloads; families offering only nanosecond micro-benches are declared unrepresented rather than mapped to a sentinel that could never clear the materiality floor. tests/test_paired_bench.py enforces completeness.

include/tess/debug/.unrepresented: dev-only ImGui helpers; no benchmark exists and none is planned

include/tess/diagnostics/.unrepresented: compile-gated ns-scale probes in the separate diagnostics bench binary; paired statistics are unreliable at that scale

include/tess/experimental/.unrepresented: evaluation-only maintenance backends, not integrated into storage

include/tess/gpu/.unrepresented: no benchmarks exist; the CPU stays authoritative and consumers own GPU pipelines

include/tess/ops/.unrepresented: the queued and scheduler benchmark families are nanosecond micro-benches below the paired materiality floor; the threshold gates cover them now and the phase 2b counter goldens gate their admission identities exactly
